text_block_list.text:
Victory unexpectedly goes to Meisho
Doto at the
Satsuki Sho. She's even
defeated Т.М. Опера О.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by surprise, Мэйсё Дото
can
hardly utter a word. She collapses,
having
exhausted her stamina and
vitality.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
